newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Small investors seen buoying Dhaka stocks.
newsitem.headline: Small investors seen buoying Dhaka stocks.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to continue their rally on small investor buying when the bourse reopens on Saturday, brokers said.
"There will be buying pressure from small investors as market sentiment is very strong," broker Moshtaque Ahmed said.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's pledge on Thursday to end a state monopoly in the telecom and power sectors would have a positive impact, he said.
Broker Shidullah Shaymol said stocks like Chittagong Cement, Apex Foods and Bengal Carbide might rise on good recent performances.
Brokers said the banking sector might also attract investors.
The DSE all share price index closed 8.05 points, or 0.7 percent, higher at 1,156.79 on Thursday on turnover 146.2 million taka.
